=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:94-107,466-495 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: review_waiting_for_runner() still counts run status queued/pending/waiting/requested, and jobs in queued/waiting/pending, as a runner wait. Phase 4 uses it for `never_assigned` without requiring status=queued and no runner_name. The watcher in scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:485 was narrowed to that rule, so the two classifiers disagree.
  WHY: A review run held by a concurrency group or environment gate gets runner_wait=true and the gate cancels itself, ending `cancelled` (no attempt used) with no heal issue filed. That hides a real blocker, which G3 forbids. Severity: four reviewers said MAJOR and gemini gave none.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:657-662,1001-1006,1019-1025 (Phase 4 wall-budget late_assigned elif) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The `late_assigned` branch checks only that the runner-wait stretch closed in the last third of the phase. It has no first-third start guard like never_assigned's. The stretch start is cleared on close, so even a single queued poll on a late-created review run qualifies.
  WHY: A review iteration that was queued briefly late in the budget and then really overran is logged `reason=late_assigned`. It writes runner_wait=true and calls `--stop-release-gate`, so the gate ends `cancelled` and the heal intake skips it, hiding a real overrun against G3.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:119-140 (dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate() `stop_real` filter `select(.conclusion == "failure" or .conclusion == "timed_out")`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "do not hide a real failure" guard counts only gate jobs whose job-level conclusion is already final. It misses an in-progress job that already has a failed step and still has conclusion null, for example the orchestrate job while its always()/failure() cleanup steps run.
  WHY: The gate cancels itself and ends `cancelled`, which auto_release_stable.sh and promote_main_cycle.sh read as no attempt used, and no heal issue is filed. A real failure is reported as a runner wait, which breaks G3.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:112-150 (jobs read, then `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/cancel`) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: There is a race (TOCTOU) between the single jobs-read failure check and the cancel POST. A gate job that fails after the read but before the cancel lands is interrupted, and its failure is lost. The comment at 112-113 admits this.
  WHY: The gate ends `cancelled` (no attempt used), so a concurrent real failure is hidden, which is the failure mode G3 forbids. Severity: two reviewers said MAJOR and gemini gave none.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:484-492,506-514 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The late-assignment test ignores job and step conclusions. A completed job whose first step started in the last third of the budget meets the late-start predicate even if the job failed.
  WHY: In a multi-job run, a late-started job can fail while another stays queued. The watcher then classifies the run as runner_wait and cancels the gate instead of keeping the real failure.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:478-514 (WATCH_JOBS_SUMMARY jq / `reason=ran_early` branch, queued_no_runner filter at 485) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A job held in waiting/pending with no runner and no started steps is logged `reason=ran_early jobs=1 queued_without_runner=0`, and test_job_waiting_on_an_environment_or_concurrency_group_is_a_timeout locks that token in.
  WHY: The timeout outcome is correct, but the contractual reason token says the child ran when it never got a runner, which misleads operators and log parsers.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1651-1700 (promote_cycle_retry_check(): `rc_jobs` read before `release_gate_oldest_queued_wait` / `outcome=wait_long`) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The costly jobs read runs before the cheaper runner-wait check that rejects most ticks.
  WHY: While the wait stays long (up to about 23-24h), each poll tick spends about 3-4 GH_PAT calls on a decision that changes only when the queue drains (§14). Reordering the checks saves one call per tick.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:4795,4808 (release_gate_oldest_queued_wait(); gh_retry default max_attempts at 2749) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The helper's documented budget of one or two reads counts gh_retry invocations, not HTTP requests, and gh_retry defaults to five attempts per read.
  WHY: On transient API errors, each read can issue up to five GETs. That exceeds the limit of two reads per tick and adds API load during an outage.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:492-496 (`bash "${E2E_RUNNER_WAIT_STOP_HELPER:-./scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh}"`), .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:691,708-720 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: E2E_RUNNER_WAIT_STOP_HELPER is not set anywhere. The pinned Phase 4 body therefore invokes main's workspace copy of dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh, which is not in the pinned sparse-checkout list.
  WHY: When main's copy lacks `--stop-release-gate`, the helper exits 2 and `|| true` swallows the error. The gate stop silently does nothing and the step fails as a generic timeout, spending the attempt the feature exists to save.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G3: "The gate then stops early, cancels the child runs it started, and the cycle ends with a conclusion the release scripts read as 'no attempt used'."
  expected_change_site: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate() and/or `if: always()` cancel steps keyed on dispatched_run_id in the .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml dispatch steps (validation-refresh ~3837, update_workflows ~3930, internal-memory-maintenance ~4012, orchestrate ~4142, internal-validate standalone ~4555)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate() cancels only GITHUB_RUN_ID (line 140), `--stop-release-gate` (lines 270-293) cancels only WATCHED_RUN_ID, and the watcher cancels only NEW_ID (line 528). The workflow's cancel paths cover only each step's own timed-out child (DW_TIMEOUT_RUN_ID at 3905/3987/4066/4219/4611) plus the pre-existing orchestrate always() cleanup (4401, scripts/stable_orchestrate_cancel_dispatched_run.sh). No hunk cancels sibling children already dispatched by other gate jobs. The editor marked this TASK_GAP_DEFERRED, citing workflow size, but the issue does not defer it.
- requirement: G3: "a child watch that reaches its budget while the watched run has a job that never got a runner (`status=queued`, no `runner_name`), or got one only in the last third of the budget, ends as `runner_wait`, not as a test failure." The issue's evidence cites gate run 45296809251, job `e2e-alt-model-test`, step "Wait for clarify→plan→implement (alt-model)", error "Alt-model run timed out before reaching review stage".
  expected_change_site: the "Wait for clarify→plan→implement (alt-model)" step of the e2e-alt-model-test job in .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (~line 5040), plus the `case "${failing_step}"` list in scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh (~lines 2068-2073)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk touches the alt-model wait step. It still polls issue labels until its 4500-second deadline (test-and-mark-stable.yml:5048) and exits with "Alt-model run timed out before reaching review stage". It never inspects runner status and writes no runner_wait result and no RELEASE_GATE_RUNNER_WAIT marker. Its step name is absent from the heal-intake failing_step case list, so the timeout still files a heal issue and spends a release attempt. The editor deferred this ("needs its own change"); the issue does not.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:Phase 4 wall-budget branch, late_assigned elif (stretch opened at lines 1001-1006, closed at lines 1019-1025 and 657-662) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `late_assigned` checks only that the stretch closed in the last third. It has no first-third start guard like never_assigned's, and the stretch start is not kept on close, so any run seen `queued` on one poll qualifies.
  WHY: A late review iteration that was queued for one poll and then really overran logs `reason=late_assigned`, writes runner_wait=true and calls `--stop-release-gate`. The gate ends `cancelled` and the heal intake skips it (`skip reason=release_gate_runner_wait`), hiding a real overrun against G3. Suggested fix: store REVIEW_RUNNER_WAIT_CLOSED_SINCE on close and require the start to fall in the first third.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:review_waiting_for_runner(), lines 100-106 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Phase 4 treats `pending`/`waiting`/`requested` runs and `waiting`/`pending` jobs as a runner-wait stretch and reports them as `never_assigned`, while the watcher was narrowed to status=queued with no runner_name.
  WHY: A run held by a concurrency group or environment gate ends with runner_wait=true and `RELEASE_GATE_RUNNER_WAIT outcome=cancel_requested`. The gate ends `cancelled` and nothing is filed, so a real blocker is hidden. Suggested fix: require RUN_STATUS queued, or only queued jobs with no runner_name.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate(), `stop_real` filter then `gh api -X POST ".../actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/cancel"` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The guard counts only jobs with a final job-level failure or timed_out conclusion. A parallel job whose step already failed keeps conclusion null while its always()/failure() cleanup runs. The comment also admits a separate window between the read and the cancel.
  WHY: The gate ends `cancelled` (no attempt used) with no heal run, so a real failure is lost. Suggested fix: `or any(.steps[]?; .conclusion == "failure")`.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:promote_cycle_retry_check(), `rc_jobs` read before `release_gate_oldest_queued_wait` / `outcome=wait_long` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The costlier jobs read runs before the cheaper wait check.
  WHY: Each poll tick spends about 3-4 GH_PAT calls (§14). Reordering saves one call per `wait_long` tick.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: G3 "The gate then stops early, cancels the child runs it started…" | Expected change site: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate(), or the test-and-mark-stable.yml dispatch steps (validation-refresh, update_workflows, internal-memory-maintenance, standalone internal-validate), each with an `if: always()` cancel | Evidence of absence: only GITHUB_RUN_ID, NEW_ID and WATCHED_RUN_ID are cancelled, and only the orchestrate always() cleanup covers a sibling; the editor deferred this, the issue does not | SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
